articles.title: Crypto trading firm FalconX confidentially files with SEC for IPO, hires bankers
articles.snippet: FalconX has hired Cantor and other bankers to advise on a potential IPO and confidentially filed draft paperwork with the SEC, though the listing is not expected until later this year amid volatile market conditions.

articles.title: Why the Ethereum Foundation is suddenly again at the center of crypto’s culture war
articles.snippet: In this week's edition of The Protocol Newsletter, we're diving deep into the institution that has been the main steward for the Ethereum blockchain, and why its been back in the spotlight.

articles.title: Tether's U.S.-focused stablecoin grows over 500% in a month, but still lags main rivals
articles.snippet: USAT's market cap jumped above $140 million in April, though it remains well behind Circle's USDC, PayPal's PYUSD and Ripple's RLUSD tokens.

articles.title: Bitwise bets Hyperliquid could power future finance as HYPE ETFs gain traction
articles.snippet: Bitwise says investor demand for Hyperliquid exposure is surging as new HYPE ETFs launch.

articles.title: Hyperliquid's pre-IPO SpaceX contracts suffers 45% flash crash, liquidating $1.5 million
articles.snippet: A massive selloff in a SpaceX crypto token wiped out hundreds of retail traders in 30 minutes because the market lacked enough cash to absorb the shock.
